findings.title: Flex layout disables the action button's right float
findings.body: Making `.small-action` a flex container turns its direct children into flex items, so the `float: right` on the button at line 306 no longer positions it at the right edge. Since the description has no `flex-grow` and the button has no auto margin, short small-action descriptions leave the button immediately after the text instead of right-aligned. Add flex alignment for the button or make the description fill the available space.
